FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.Name: Logistics yard
FlowerPainter.Recipe.LogisticsYard.Descr: A storage and loading yard laid out like a parking lot: container stacks, pallets, crates or lumber in blocks between drive aisles, truck loading bays, sheds and floodlights.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.style.Toolti: What fills the storage blocks. Mixed varies the goods from block to block.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.aisleWidth.T: Width of the drive aisles between the storage blocks (forklifts need 4 m, trucks 8 m or more).
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.blockDepth.T: Depth of each storage block between two aisles. Deeper blocks hold more rows.
Length of a storage block before the next cross aisle.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.fill.Tooltip: Share of the storage slots that hold goods. Lower looks like a yard mid-shift.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.angle.Toolti: Rotates the aisle grid against the area's long axis.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.dockSide.Too: Where the truck loading bays go: the edge far from the entrance (back), near it (front), two edges, or none.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.trucks.Toolt: Share of the loading bays with a truck or trailer backed in.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.sheds.Toolti: Warehouse sheds or lean-tos along the edge behind the loading bays.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.machines.Too: Forklifts, reach stackers and yard tractors per hectare, working the aisles.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.gatehouse.To: A guard booth and boom barrier at the main entrance.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.office.Toolt: A site office cabin next to the entrance lane.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.markings.Too: Painted aisle lines, block outlines and bay lines (hard ground only).
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.stains.Toolt: Oil, dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², in clumps.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.level.Toolti: Levels the yard so stacks stand flat, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent).
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.buffer.Toolt: A planted strip of this width between the outline and the yard.
FlowerPainter.LogisticsYard.Issue.NoBuff: Logistics yard: the area is too narrow for the green buffer; the yard fills it all.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.YardBreak.Name: Break area
FlowerPainter.AddOn.YardBreak.cabin.Tool: A cabin or shed for the yard crew.
